about: Calibration cases for the taste critic (TASTE.md section 5). Each case is a fictional kit example with one fault put back by a CSS file; the anchor is the same example without the fault. expect: rubric line number -> the highest (max) or lowest (min) score the critic may give. A case passes when every expectation holds.

cases.fault: none: the anchor judged against itself
a full-width band in an electric brand blue
a heavy condensed wordmark beside a warm serif and a soft sans
the sell text and button nudged off the column edges
a soft hero photo that no measured check catches
